technical_details: Parquet columnar storage allows readers to ignore columns that are not present in older files.
Parquet readers can project only the columns required by the reader.
Parquet normally matches columns by name. Renaming requires explicit projection or table-format column identity such as Iceberg or Delta.
PyArrow and Parquet support compatible numeric type conversions during Arrow table operations.
Avro schema resolution inserts the reader schema default value when the writer schema does not contain the new field.
Avro reader schema can ignore fields that exist in the writer schema but are absent from the reader schema.
Avro aliases allow a renamed reader field to resolve against the old writer field name.
Avro supports numeric promotion such as int to long and long to float.
SequenceFiles store raw Key/Value byte streams without schema headers. Schema evolution depends on the application-layer serialization.
Application-layer deserializers can ignore attributes that are no longer required.
SequenceFile does not provide built-in schema resolution or field aliases. Renaming requires application-level mapping.
Compatibility depends on the payload serialization. Dynamic payloads can handle numeric widening, while rigid Writable types may not.
